description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kumbuka, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District  - Cad. Map No. 530176
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and property encumbrances for multiple land parcels in the Kalutara District. The content falls under "PART III - LANDS" and involves land settlement determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement, making it clearly a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
